svg.text: The 11 process steps an agent follows, per "Lots Process Documents 2026". Part 1 is the flow; Part 2 is the SOP detail behind every step.
17 sections · 80 detail items, reproduced in full. Where the SOP contradicts itself,
both statements are shown so the process owner can settle it.

PART 2 — THE SOP DETAIL BEHIND EVERY STEP
Inbound call · Missed call · Email (case auto-created) · Outbound
Greeting: "Good morning! [Name] this side from Lots Wholesale Solution. How may I
Hold: explain the reason · ask for phone number in case the call is cut · give best
Delay longer than a couple of minutes: ask for a number and a time to call back
MISSED / ABANDONED CALL — CALL BACK WITHIN 30 MIN
Reasons: agent busy on another call · caller hung up · non-working hours
No missed call should be left unattended
Call back, ask the query and give a satisfactory resolution
Case auto-created in CRM on mail receipt · complaint number generated · status
Call the customer to understand complete details — details are updated on the same case
Categorise by contact and case type · reply as per the template provided
Lead call → order on call (OMS) / offer info / concern raised
New registration — enquired about membership via app / website → explain process and
Inactive customer — ask the issue they face in purchasing → resolve concerns → share
Order on call — inform offers, schemes, prices → place order on call (recorded in OMS)
LCC (Lots Club Card) — delivery within 24 hours, zero delivery charges, personal
Confirmation / resolution — is the customer satisfied, concern resolved?
Festival & seasonal offers — invite to visit store or shop on app
Opening: "Namaskar! Main [Name] bol raha hoon LOTS Wholesale Solutions se. Kya abhi
aapse baat karne ka yeh sahi samay hai?"
Offer example: ₹99 voucher on ₹999+ shopping at Akshardham (code via SMS &
B2C info: AKD & NSP — shop without documentation, food items only

Registered member · Not registered · B2C customer

of Indian origin only · no e-commerce

ENQUIRY — USUALLY ANSWERED ON THE CALL
General: store timings, address, membership process & documents, supplier
registration, product availability / stock / price, payment modes, add-on cards, delivery
Store: rude / unsupportive staff · price mismatch · wrong products billed · GST issue ·
late / incomplete delivery · poor quality / near expiry · freebie not given · SMS coupon
App/E-comm: site not opening · wrong profile details · OTP / login · incomplete order ·
wrong products · overcharged · incorrect invoice · refund · poor quality / near expiry ·
BDA: incomplete order · wrong products · order cancelled without communication ·
rude / unsupportive BDA · pricing · quality · delayed delivery (dispatched / not
Membership: change registered contact number · update business address / licence ·
new add-on card · reissue / block card
Store: reissue invoice · GST request · return / exchange · increase stock
App/E-comm: cancel order · return order · refund
Not registered member: new membership · new supplier registration
Call: agent creates case · Email: auto-created case is updated
Case type and category (by contact and case type)
Product category: Fresh · FMCG Food · Commodities · FMCG Non-food · Non-food
New membership — any one: GST · FSSAI · Drug licence · Certificate of Incorporation ·
Society / Trust registration · APMC · Govt authorisation letter · MSME / Udyam ·
Weights & Measures · Trade licence · Shops & Establishments
New membership — no GST: visiting card · menu photo · copy of bill · hoarding board ·
New membership — mandatory: PAN · mobile no. · Aadhaar · selfie · store preference
Consent form: offline → sign in store · online → store emails PDF → customer prints,
signs, scans, sends back to store email
Add-on card: authority letter on business letterhead (or A4 with business stamp +
signature) · Aadhaar · photo · mobile of person added · linked to owner card · SOP:
only 1 per customer / FAQ: up to 4
Supplier registration: company profile + product catalogue to contactus@cpwi.in · reply
Lost card: application on business letterhead + valid govt ID at store or to
Change delivery address: new address proof + govt-approved business licence +
Return / exchange: original bill stamped by store guard · no bill → store verifies
Offer SMS not received: missed call to 08061914105 from registered number ·
Bulk booking: contact store helpdesk or email product details and quantity
Resolve on call · Info missing · Escalate to store
Stores open 7 days · Delhi NCR only · membership is free
Privilege card: ₹799 / ₹1450 / ₹1499 · valid 3–6 months · in-store only
Returns: within 7 working days with original invoice · packaging intact, unused,
saleable, with free articles, before expiry · credit note valid 1 year, single purchase
Not returnable: oil, ghee, fresh dairy, fruits, vegetables, meat, fish,
No warranty from LOTS — manufacturer / brand warranty and service centres apply
Delivery: free on ₹9,000+ · handling ₹69 GNI / ₹99 others (waived for the month after 8+
orders) · shipping by article · business licence address only · within 25 km · TAT 2–3
App / website MOV: HoReCa (QSR, multi-cuisine, speciality, budget hotel 1–3★, street
food, online food, pub & bar) ₹3,000 · others: NSP 9000 · Ithum 6000 · AKD 3000 & 6000
Payment: credit / debit cards (except AmEx), cash, Paytm · split payment allowed
Online order: website / app with registered mobile · cancel any time before Dispatched
Amount debited but not received: auto-refund within 7 working days or contact bank
Billed items cannot be held / pre-booked · no loyalty programme currently
BDA: field representatives take orders at registered business address
"Is there anything else I can assist you with?"
Yes → handle the next concern (back to case type)
No → "Thank you for your time and for contacting Lots Wholesale Solution. Have a great
Email customer for missing info · stays Waiting until they reply
Status transition — no SOP detail recorded.
As per escalation matrix · daily call to store · CRM updated after each call
"Good afternoon XYZ ji, Main [Your Name] bol rahi hoon, Lots Wholesale Solutions ke
customer support se. Pending cases ke regarding follow-up karna tha. Current status
aur resolution timeline batane ki kripa karein."
Closing: "Jankari dene ke liye shukriya. Dhanyavaad!"
CRM note: "Had a discussion with the store contact person, [Name]. As per the update,
the case is still pending due to [reason]. A follow-up email has been sent to the store."
Follow-up email: "Dear Sir, As per our discussion over the call regarding the pending
case, we kindly request you to share an update on the same at the earliest."
Store replies by email · agent calls customer to confirm
Status transition — no SOP detail recorded.
Customer confirms → case closed from our end
